questions.stem: What is the correct sequence of events in protein synthesis?

options.text: Transcription in the cytoplasm, then translation in the nucleus
Transcription in the nucleus, then translation at the ribosomes
Translation at the ribosomes, then transcription in the cytoplasm

questions.explanation: Protein synthesis occurs in two stages: first, transcription in the nucleus (DNA is copied to mRNA), then translation at the ribosomes in the cytoplasm (mRNA is used to assemble amino acids into a protein).
